card.story: Sam is 6 and in 1st grade. Sam loves building with blocks and anything about the ocean, especially octopuses. Big, loud groups are hard, and Sam may freeze and stop talking. A heads-up before each change helps, and so does holding the small stuffed octopus from home. When Sam starts rocking or covers both ears, a quiet corner helps. Sam is allergic to tree nuts and has an EpiPen in the front pocket of the backpack. Only me (Jordan) or Aunt Lena may pick Sam up.
